paper.title: Learning in Volatile Environments With the Bayes Factor Surprise
paper.implemented_approximation: two-hypothesis Bayesian update followed by declared single full-joint moment projection; not VarSMiLe, Monte Carlo, or an exact full-history posterior

probability_unit: one fresh nonempty valid observation packet; one common change variable across enabled sensors
reset_kernel: redraw command-dependent direct initial body family independently of retained environment; preserve retained unknown-marker marginal and root-fixed goal memory
valid_packet_evidence: normalized same-observation-space joint evidence including shared-body reference-product correction
posterior_change_probability_semantics: posterior mass of the declared reset hypothesis; not a detector of all model violations, absolute-pose correctness, or physical success

executed_local_search.explanation: The finite local wrist search is at most +/-0.02 rad. Its measured Cartesian motion is small and does not imply a promised Cartesian radius; after exhausting the pattern it deliberately holds.

limitations: The requested change model and normalized evidence weighting are verified. These measurements do not demonstrate that body-pose overconfidence has been resolved.

A Bayes factor compares the continuation and supplied reset predictive models. It does not establish absolute pose correctness; limited observability or approximation/model mismatch may remain. These are possible explanations, not identified causes.

The covariance-region checks compare deterministic physical-reference errors with each Gaussian proxy. They are descriptive coverage counts on these trajectories, not a repeated-trial calibration theorem.
Actual five-channel wire checks cover the two full marker-enabled runs. IMU-only and no-sensor results are explicitly shorter headless supplemental trials, not full live RViz comparisons.
Physical truth, URDF equilibrium FK, switch truth and trajectory references are read only by the validation path, never fed into inference or command selection.
Independent received-pixel verification of the Image topic was not performed. Distribution and scene MarkerArrays were captured and checked as actual serialized ROS wire messages.
No video was recorded for this change.

discarded_audit_attempt.reason: validation-only reconstruction used the old component label instead of the recorded predicted label; runtime was unchanged

additional_marker_conflict_analysis.semantics: separate read-only diagnostics on selected source frames; absolute-pose error and relative-observation compatibility are distinct, not an identified causal diagnosis
